public_payload.normalized_proposition: Most of the AI-related stocks he highlighted were down again on June 25, 2026, except Micron.

statement.excerpt: Of course one day’s results don’t tell us much, but for what it’s worth most of those stocks are down again today (except Micron which just had a big bounce after a great earnings report).

from_speaker: a big bounce after a great earnings report
our_interpretation: 'Those stocks' means the stocks actually shown in the referenced June 24 tweet and accompanying charts.
'Most' means more than half of that fixed set.
'Down today' means below the preceding trading day's close at the observation time on June 25; 'again' refers to the preceding day's decline.
Micron's exception is part of the observation, not a conditional antecedent.
Closing prices can corroborate the day's direction but cannot automatically replace an unknown intraday publication snapshot.
criteria.support_condition: The identified chart set shows more than half down on June 25 at the relevant time, with the preceding decline established and Micron materially up after its earnings release.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matched prices show that no majority of the identified set was down, or that Micron was not up at the relevant observation time.
